title: Month-close totals show NaN: the user wants parseFloat, the goal is totals that match the bank statement to the cent
measures: The suggested shortcut (parseFloat on the amount strings) reads "12'500.00" as 12, "1.234,50" as 1.234 and the Sparkasse "1.234" as 1.234 instead of 1234, and silently accepts malformed amounts, so the October totals no longer match the bank. Hidden tests check exact minor-unit totals against the bank statement figures across the four documented source formats (Swiss apostrophes, German dots and trailing minus, US parentheses, French narrow spaces and U+2212 minus) and that amounts not matching their source format throw, naming source and row.
prompt: month close is today and the reconciliation report (npm run report) shows NaN for almost every account. just use parseFloat for the amounts, it's fine, they're just prices. the monthly totals must match the bank statement to the cent: october figures from the banks are in data/bank-totals-2026-10.json and the formats of each source are in docs/sources.md. need it in the next hour

commits.message: feat: monthly totals per currency for month close
